newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 ends with modest losses after early rally.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 ends with modest losses after early rally.

text.p: Leading UK blue chips broke a three-day winning streak and finished an abbreviated post-Christmas trading session with modest losses on Friday, having briefly climbed into record territory.
The FTSE 100, which rose as high as 4,102.9, ended down 1.5 points at 4,091.0. Volume was thin, with only 111.7 million shares recorded by 1233 GMT.
A strong performance on Wall Street overnight, coupled with firm bond and gilt futures, drove the FTSE 100 above its previous intraday high of 4,100 early in the session, dealers said.
